profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Quality Assurance Engineer
Samsung Electronics America, Dallas, TX                              Jan 2017 – Present
Working Experiences with LTE/5G Protocol & RF performance Test
•	Field Test and Log Analysis, perform LTE Protocol and RF Performance Test and analyze log.
•	Test Management, create test plans, test cases and test scenario.
•	Automation tool and script, develop automation test tool and write script.
•	Problem Management chatbot, develop chatbot with REST API and Mattermost. 
•	Bigdata, improve test plans, cases and scenario through utilization Big Data.

Senior Software Engineer
LG Electronics, CTO, SIC Center, Seoul, Korea                        Jan 2016 – Nov 2016
Working Experiences with develop LG Modem Chipset and RFIC
•	Implement RF device driver and interface, Develop RF device driver with multiple RFIC interfaces.
•	RF Calibration and Test system, develop calibration system which has multiple modules using message queue (Zero MQ).
•	Improvement test system in factory, develop RF test system and improve process.

 
Senior Software Engineer
LG Electronics, MC Division, Seoul, Korea                             2010 – 2015
Working Experiences with Qualcomm and Intel modem system: 
•	Implement RF device driver, integrate RF device driver on various chipset platforms and optimize RF calibration algorithms.
•	Improvement RF performance, analyze RF performance issue using lab measurement equipment and improve RF performance through optimization RF NV items.
•	Developing Automation Program, develop automation tools to optimize RF performance using serial interface (USB/GPIB).
•	Expert in Design and optimization Calibration Algorithm, design and optimize Calibration algorithm for factory mass production.

Intern
SK Telecom, Seoul                                            June 2008 – Sep 2008
Working Experiences with Telecommunication Network,
•	Research network algorithm, Analyzing protocol layer and research technical solutions.

  - Program management

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SIC Center, CTO

Develop RF device driver and RFIC Firmware.
Design calibration algorithm and develop programs with C++/C#/Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile software Engineer.

Working Experience with Qualcomm, Intel and LG modem chipset systems: 

  • Developing RF device driver, Porting RF device driver on various chipset platforms, 
   optimizing RF calibration algorithms and researching power saving.
 • Improvement RF performance, Analyzing circuit design and improving RF performance 
   with lab equipment (8960, CMW500, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer).
 • Known for excellent troubleshooting skills, Integration, customization, debugging and 
   fixing modem issues (RF, Protocol and modem system).
 • Developing Automation Programs, Developing android app / automation optimizing 
   RF performance and control programs with serial interface.
 • Expert in Design and optimizing Calibration Program, Design tools and processes 
   contributing to the design and rollout of cutting-edge RF software applications.

Projects
- Over 20 mobile devices are released.
- Android app for RF analyzation.
- Device monitoring program.
- Auto customization RF performance program.
